name: Progress
summary: How much of something is done. The bar is a groove with a fill inside it, and the fill takes its width from the host.
summaryZh: 一件事完成了多少。进度条是一条槽,里面填一段,填充宽度由宿主给。

variants.name: Success
variants.note: The fill takes the success colour.

variants.name: Warning
variants.note: The fill takes the warning colour.

variants.name: Danger
variants.note: The fill takes the danger colour.

states.name: Indeterminate
states.note: The bar moves along the track without a value to show, so it says that something is happening and not how much of it is done.

states.name: Show the percentage
states.note: The percentage is written under the bar.

states.name: Striped
states.note: The fill is striped, the way a bar of hazard tape is.

states.name: Striped and flowing
states.note: The stripes travel along the bar.

parts.name: Track
parts.note: The groove. It is the full width and hides what is behind the fill.

parts.name: Bar
parts.note: The fill. Its width comes from the host as an inline style, because the value is data and no class can carry a number.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The text below the bar. Optional — leave the element out to hide it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which state the fill paints. The base class is already the primary progress, so a plain um-progress needs no modifier at all.
props.descriptionZh: 填充用哪种状态色。基础类本身就是主色进度,所以只写 um-progress 时不需要任何修饰类。

props.name: value
props.description: How much is done, as a percentage of the track. It is written to the inline width of the bar.
props.descriptionZh: 完成了多少,按轨道的百分比算。它写在填充条的内联宽度上。

props.name: status
props.description: Which state the fill paints, under the name Element Plus gives it. It falls back to the variant when it is left out.
props.descriptionZh: 填充用哪种状态色,用的是 Element Plus 的叫法。不传就以变体为准。

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Runs the bar along the track without a value to show. The animation is wrapped in the motion contract, so a reader who asked for less motion gets a still bar.
props.descriptionZh: 让填充条在轨道上走,不给一个具体的量。动画包在动效约定里,所以要求减弱动效的用户看到的是静止的进度条。

props.name: show-text
props.description: Writes the percentage under the bar.
props.descriptionZh: 在进度条下面写出百分比。

props.name: striped
props.description: Strips the fill, the way a bar of hazard tape is.
props.descriptionZh: 给填充加上条纹,像警示胶带那样。

props.name: striped-flow
props.description: Lets the stripes travel along the bar. The animation is wrapped in the motion contract.
props.descriptionZh: 让条纹沿着进度条流动。动画包在动效约定里。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content of the bar. It sits on the fill, so it has to read against it.
slots.descriptionZh: 进度条里的内容。它压在填充上,所以得在填充上读得清。

a11y.notes: A progress bar is read, not operated: it is not focusable. Put role="progressbar" on the container with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax, and the value is announced when it changes. The painted bar carries no value of its own, so the ARIA attributes are the whole contract.
a11y.notesZh: 进度条是被读的,不是被操作的:它不可聚焦。在容器上写 role="progressbar",再配上 aria-valuenow、aria-valuemin 和 aria-valuemax,数值变化时就会被播报。画出来的进度条本身不带任何数值,所以 ARIA 属性就是全部的约定。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: The base class is the primary progress. The three modifiers paint the fill with the success, warning and danger colours instead.
examples.descriptionZh: 基础类就是主色进度。三个修饰类把填充换成成功、警告和危险色。

examples.title: With a label
examples.description: The label is a separate element, so it can be left out. The role and the aria values belong on the container, not on the bar.
examples.descriptionZh: 文字是独立的元素,可以不写。role 和 aria 的值要写在容器上,不是写在填充条上。
examples.markup: 68% of the plan limit

notes: The width of the fill is set by the host, not by a class: it is a number that changes, and a class cannot carry a number. The track and the fill are both rounded, and the track hides what is behind it, so the fill never escapes the groove at any width.
notesZh: 填充的宽度由宿主设置,而不是靠一个类:它是一个会变的数字,而类带不了数字。轨道和填充都是圆角,轨道会把后面的东西挡住,所以不管填充多宽都不会跑出槽外。
